## Introduction

ariadneApp is a web app version of the ariadne package designed to interactively
weave resources across the ariadne graph.

## Tutorial

### Installation

### Example

The app can be launched with `shinePath()`.

```{r start, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Import ariadneApp
library(ariadneApp)

# Launch ariadneApp
if (interactive()) {
    shinePath()
}
```

```{r screenplot1, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
SCREENSHOT("screenshots/initial.png", delay = 20)
```

By zooming in, it is possible to focus on specific regions of the graph. With a
long press, you can select nodes to link. Single click on empty areas to remove
the selection.

```{r screenplot2, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
SCREENSHOT("screenshots/path.png", delay = 20)
```

Selecting `resources` will subset the graph to the chosen ones.

`Prune`, `Focus`.

```{r screenplot3, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
SCREENSHOT("screenshots/subset.png", delay = 20)
```

### Background

ariadneApp originates from the joint effort of the R/Bioconductor community. It
is mainly based on the following software:

- [R](https://www.r-project.org/), statistical programming language [@r2026]
- [ariadne](https://codeberg.org/Minotau-R/ariadne), framework for multi-modal
  integration of biological data [@ariadne2026]
- [visNetwork](https://cran.r-project.org/package=visNetwork), interactive
  network visualisation [@visnetwork2025]
- [shiny](https://cran.r-project.org/package=shiny), web app development in R
  [@shiny2026]
